Are caffeine pouches legal in the UK?

Yes. Caffeine pouches are legal to buy and sell in the UK, and there is currently no specific law setting an age limit for them. Vape Online Store sells it's Caffeine Pouches to adults aged 18 and over only, in line with most UK retailers, and every can is labelled with its caffeine strength.
Are caffeine pouches healthier than coffee?

We do not make that claim. it's Caffeine Pouches contain the same active ingredient as coffee, caffeine, and the same Food Standards Agency guidance of up to 400mg a day applies to both. The practical differences are that a pouch is sugar-free, needs no cup, and gives a measured 50mg or 100mg dose.
Do caffeine pouches give a buzz?

A caffeine pouch gives the same alertness you would expect from the equivalent amount of coffee. A 100mg it's Caffeine Pouches pouch is roughly one cup, and many users notice a tingle under the lip for the first minute or two as it releases. If you are new to them, start on 50mg.

You place one pouch between your upper lip and gum and leave it for as long as the tin suggests, typically around 20 to 30 minutes. The caffeine in it's Caffeine Pouches releases gradually and is absorbed through the mouth lining. Do not chew or swallow the pouch; when you are done, bin it.
Caffeine pouches vs nicotine pouches: what is the difference?

The format is the same slim pouch under the upper lip, but the active ingredient is different. it's Caffeine Pouches contain 50mg or 100mg of caffeine and no nicotine or tobacco, while a nicotine pouch contains nicotine and no caffeine. If you want nicotine, see our nicotine pouches collection instead; these will not replace it.

Caffeine pouches contain caffeine, and the official UK guidance is the measure to use. The Food Standards Agency says up to 400mg a day is unlikely to cause adverse effects in healthy adults, and advises 200mg a day in pregnancy. it's Caffeine Pouches are for adults 18 and over; 50mg is the sensible start.
Are caffeine pouches bad for your gums?

Any pouch held in the same spot for long periods can irritate the gum, so move it's Caffeine Pouches to a different spot each time, keep each pouch in for the suggested time only, and rest your gums between pouches. If soreness does not settle, stop using them and speak to a dentist.
How many it's Caffeine Pouches can I have a day?

Count all your caffeine, not just the pouches. The Food Standards Agency figure for healthy adults is up to 400mg a day from every source, so two coffees already use around 200mg. That leaves room for two 100mg it's Caffeine Pouches, or four 50mg pouches, at most. Space them out and avoid bedtime.
